name: Zyphari
notes: Insectoid, highly communal beings emphasizing long-term investment and economic dominance; the dominant species of the Zyphari corporate confederation (which is itself multispecies). Primary polity: Zyphari Compact.

naming_exemption.reason: Species name "Zyphari" preserved verbatim from the cited species/civilization codex.

distribution: Dominant species of the Zyphari Compact, but the Compact is explicitly MULTISPECIES — Zyphari are its most prominent members, not its only ones. Zyphari also appear in Union trade contexts.
identity_model_note: Species = a people (biology + broad cultural origin). Membership is not bounded by any single polity/faction; see member_polities (non-exhaustive) and distribution.

promotion_to_canon.rule: owner directive: promote all staged records that do not conflict with canon
promotion_to_canon.conflict_scan: zero name/office collisions; fabric linter clean; position axis unchanged

origin_polity_id_note: origin_polity_id carries the FACTION-binding form ("zyphari_compact"), which is also what polity_zyphari_compact.faction_bindings uses — so the value is meaningful, not a typo. It is simply not an entity id. origin_polity_entity_id is added alongside rather than rewriting it, the same additive pattern used when entity_id was added beside canonical_id, so neither namespace is lost.

naming_convention.rule: Zyphari names often carry affiliation metadata — guild, holding or division — in the position humans use for a surname.
naming_convention.implication: A Zyphari name encodes economic allegiance rather than descent, which is consistent with a people organised around guilds and holdings.
naming_convention.comparison: Structurally parallel to the Velar lineage-prefix system already in canon, but keyed to affiliation rather than bloodline.
naming_convention.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Zyphari species/polity split, 2026-08-27

cultural_practices.enclave_homogeneity: Zyphari corporate enclaves are among the worlds maintaining strict cultural homogeneity, where non-natives must adhere to local custom. Harkon military training worlds are cited alongside them as the other example of enforced cultural zones.
cultural_practices.psychic_projection_arenas: A corporate-controlled Zyphari sport. Recorded as a cultural institution under corporate control; the source names the sport and does not attribute psionic capability to the Zyphari, so none is inferred.
cultural_practices.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Zyphari species/polity split, 2026-08-27

resolved_prose_question.question: Early prose left open whether "Zyphari" denotes a species or a corporate nationality spanning multiple peoples.
resolved_prose_question.resolution: Settled by committed canon. species_zyphari.identity_model_note holds species as a people; polity_zyphari_compact.peoplehood_note holds the Compact as a state with explicitly multispecies membership, of which the Zyphari are the dominant founding species. Both, not either.
resolved_prose_question.status: CLOSED — answered by the committed identity model.
